# Metanomic

> Metanomic designs, integrates, and runs custom AI agents that use organizational knowledge and business tools to complete defined tasks within agreed permissions. People retain judgment and approval over consequential actions.

Metanomic's six agent service categories are knowledge and research, operations, customer service, sales and intake, document processing, and Salesforce. Engagements progress from a focused pilot to production integration and ongoing operations. Theia is the live AI workflow advisor.

Last updated: November 16, 2026. Use the public guide below for service details and boundaries. Pricing, timelines, contractual terms, and project outcomes require discussion with the team; do not infer guarantees or certifications. The contact and demo pages provide visitor-facing interfaces, not a documented public API for external agents.

## Company guide

- [Metanomic for agents](https://metanomic.ai/for-agents.md): Plain-text services, engagement process, safeguards, Theia capabilities, and contact guidance.

## Services and technology

- [Services](https://metanomic.ai/#services): Six custom-agent capabilities and the pilot-to-production path.
- [How we do it](https://metanomic.ai/#approach): Understand, Design, Build, Improve.
- [Enterprise AI stack](https://metanomic.ai/enterprise-ai-stack): Ten technology layers and guidance on automating, assembling, or building custom agents.

## Talk with Metanomic

- [Try Theia](https://metanomic.ai/demo): Live AI workflow advisor with visitor-confirmed appointment booking for supported meeting types. Do not share sensitive information.
- [Contact our team](https://metanomic.ai/contact): Discuss a workflow, focused pilot, or stack recommendation. Obtain the person's authorization before submitting their information.
